Names: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
Synopsis:
Killed on the battlefield without glory to his name, Yuseong Dan receives an opportunity to grow stronger with a strange quest and level system.

But each quest he’s forced to fight only seems to be getting harder and harder. Can he level up enough to avoid the same miserable ending and become the powerful hero he wishes to be?

Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him.

But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital and embrace the destiny he was meant for?

Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life.

Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game. Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

A 34-year-old NEET gets killed in a traffic accident and finds himself in a world of magic. Rather than waking up as a full-grown mage, he gets reincarnated as a newborn baby, retaining the memories of his past life.

Before he can even properly move his body, he resolves to never make the same mistakes he made in his first life ever again and instead live a life with no regrets.

Because he has the knowledge of a middle-aged man, by the age of two he has already become a prodigy, possessing power unthinkable for anyone his age. Thus begins the chronicles of Rudeus Greyrat as he sets out to become the strongest mage the world has ever known.

A 34-year-old unemployed shut-in dies in a tragic accident and awakens in a world of swords and magic as Rudeus Greyrat. Reborn with the memories of his previous life, he vows to seize this second chance and live without regrets.

Gifted with extraordinary magical talent from a young age, Rudeus embarks on a journey filled with powerful allies, dangerous enemies, and life-changing adventures as he strives to become one of the greatest mages the world has ever known.

Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses, a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy.

In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive. There are two big problems, though. One, Eleonora is actually alive, a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can't seem to coordinate their movements.

Can this unlikely duo overcome every obstacle, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

The war between humans and vampires has ended with the vampires' victory. In a final effort to fight back, human refugees in the Holy Land of Bahal successfully create an undying Corpse Knight powered by a mysterious energy source.

Gunther, a former gladiator turned immortal warrior, becomes humanity's last hope in a desperate struggle for survival.

Corruption. Greed. War. Lev has spent his entire life fighting the system that enslaved humanity and turned its people into puppets for those in power.

When he is assassinated, however, he awakens in another world plagued by different, yet strangely familiar evils.

Armed with the experience of a lifetime, Lev sets out to challenge this new world's corruption before history can repeat itself.

An immortal being is sent to the surface of the Earth, where it encounters a lonely boy living in the frozen tundra.

Possessing the ability to take the form of anything that dies before it, as long as the emotional impact is strong enough, the mysterious being begins an endless journey.

What experiences, friendships, and hardships await someone destined to live forever?

Somewhere in Tokyo, there is a room containing a mysterious black sphere. People who should have died are periodically transported there instead.

The sphere equips them with advanced suits and weapons before sending them on deadly missions to eliminate aliens hiding on Earth, all while the rest of the world remains completely unaware.

Few participants survive these missions, and the sphere shows no mercy. Its name is... Gantz.
